Гинкго.about: In pathology (dementia, post-stroke), EGb-761 can support cognition; in healthy people there is no effect.
Гинкго.caution: Cochrane reviews on dementia: effect is STATISTICALLY small, NOT clinically significant. For cognitive functions in healthy people there is NO effect. Risk of bleeding (antiplatelet effect) - be careful with anticoagulants. DOES NOT prevent dementia (large RCT GEM, n=3069).
Гинкго.guidelines: EFSA: claims not approved. Cochrane: In dementia, effect is modest and inconsistent; in healthy people - not confirmed.

interactions.note: enhances the effect, risk of bleeding

mechs: In healthy people, meta-analyses are negative
Antioxidant activity of the extract: neutralizes free radicals
Fewer manifestations of tardive dyskinesia in patients on antipsychotics
Cognition, activities of daily living and quality of life in dementia and stroke
Гинкго.myths: “Improves memory for everyone” - an effect with age-related decline, not in healthy people. “Safe with aspirin” – risk of bleeding.
Гинкго.name: Ginkgo
Гинкго.onset: Cognitive functions - 12-24 weeks; only for pathology, for healthy people there is no data.
Гинкго.title: Ginkgo
Гинкго.who_needs: Only with confirmed pathology: mild/moderate dementia (adjuvant), ischemic stroke. Healthy people don’t need it.
